description: This file defines a GUI toolbar component (ECUEditorToolBar) for an ECU editor application, including buttons for uploading, downloading, and burning ECU images, along with associated event handling and icon management.

classes.name: ECUEditorToolBar
classes.description: A Swing toolbar component providing controls for ECU image operations such as upload, download, and burn within the ECU editing environment.

methods.name: ECUEditorToolBar
methods.description: Constructor initializing the toolbar with buttons and event handlers.

methods.name: updateIcons
methods.description: Updates toolbar button icons based on settings.

methods.name: rescaleImageIcon
methods.description: Returns a scaled version of the provided ImageIcon.

methods.name: updateButtons
methods.description: Updates the enabled state of buttons based on current editor state.
